CoreWeave reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3.661B (+168% YoY, beating ~$3.54B–$3.55B consensus); GAAP net loss widened to $709M (-$1.27/sh) from $110M a year ago; adjusted (non-GAAP) operating income was $379M (+75% YoY); quarter-end revenue backlog was ~$132.5B; raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $13.0B–$13.3B and capex guidance to $37B–$39B.

catalysts.headline: CoreWeave reports Q3 2026 results: revenue $3.66B (+168% YoY, beat ~$3.54B consensus), net loss widens to $709M from $110M a year earlier; raises FY2026 revenue guidance to $13.0B-$13.3B
catalysts.impact: Revenue beat and raised guidance, but widening losses, heavy capex (~$14.5B/quarter vs ~$9B in customer prepayments), ~$47B debt, and customer concentration (top 3 customers = 72% of quarterly revenue) drove a mixed stock reaction

catalysts.headline: CoreWeave Q3 2026 results: revenue $3.661B (+168% YoY from $1.365B), beating the ~$3.54-3.55B analyst estimate; GAAP net loss $709M (vs $110M prior-year quarter) on operating income of $207M; revenue backlog ~$132.5B; raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $13.0B-$13.3B (from prior guidance on file); still expects >1.85GW of active power capacity by year-end; total debt reported approaching $47B
catalysts.impact: Shares fell to $47.56 after-hours (-2.4%) despite the beat/guidance raise, as coverage flagged the ~$14.5B quarterly capex against only ~$9B of customer prepayments

catalysts.headline: CoreWeave signed a multi-year agreement to power Wayve's AI Driver training using NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs (training, evaluation and simulation for Wayve's autonomous-driving foundation models); no contract value, GPU count or duration disclosed; shares fell ~3% in pre-market trading on the news
